**`gambit_cli/m2dot input.mtx -o output.dot`**

```ruby
# Example for streaming output to a file
File.open("output.partial.dot", "w") do |file|
  # Process and write sections of the DOT format iteratively.
  1000.times { |i| file.write("subgraph \"part#{i}\"{"; end }
  500.times { |j| file.write('  edge path;"'; end }
end
```

Concatenate partial files afterward to form the complete visualization. This approach ensures efficient memory usage while handling large graphs with Gambit CLI.
